subtitle: Manage your personal preferences and system settings
page_subtitle: Manage personal, teaching, and system settings based on your permissions.

profile.title: Personal profile
profile.description: These contact details belong to your personal profile. Your sign-in email stays separate.

security.title: Account security
security.description: Change your sign-in email or password. Your current password is required to verify your identity.
security.email_confirmation_hint: A confirmation link will be sent to the new email address. It will become your sign-in email after confirmation.
security.password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
security.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
security.request_failed: The change could not be completed. Please try again.
security.email_confirmation_sent: A confirmation link has been sent to the new email address.

timezone.title: Time Zone Settings
timezone.description: Configure the time zone used for displaying times. This affects your class schedule, report times, and all time-related features.
timezone.search_placeholder: Search region or city (e.g., Taipei, London, UTC...)

appearance.title: Appearance & Personalization
appearance.description: Customize how the interface looks for a more comfortable experience.
appearance.font_scale_hint: Changes will be applied immediately to all pages.

teacher_roles.title: Teacher Role Types
teacher_roles.description: Manage roles available for class assignments. Built-in roles cannot be removed.

teaching_role_permissions.title: Teaching Role Permissions
teaching_role_permissions.description: Manage teaching role access to student, teacher, classroom, class-session, attendance, report, holiday and enrollment operations at teaching and classroom scopes. System administration permissions are managed separately.

incomplete_notifications.title: Incomplete Report Notifications
incomplete_notifications.description: Choose which assigned roles receive incomplete-report reminders on the dashboard.
incomplete_notifications.inheritance_hint: Each role uses the most specific class, classroom, then system policy. A deny on any assigned role takes priority.
